sections.label: 00 · DECK — Makita Brand/CPT Storyboards (39pp)
sections.note: Hand-drawn storyboard SAMPLE spots for Makita power tools (THD preread, 2024). 9 spots. No corresponding produced video found (S3 has only Makita chainsaw product clips; these brand/CPT spots aren't public). We generate from the sketch frames directly. Taglines: 'Makita. Built to be the best.' / 'When it calls for the best, call on Makita.'

sections.label: 0001 · Shot 901 — Hit The Mark: circular saw (DONE)
sections.note: Pipeline: storyboard sketch → nano photoreal render → i2v. Blade spins, sawdust sprays, camera zooms in. No face (hands only). VO: 'BUILT TO HIT THE MARK.'

sections.label: Inputs — sketch → photoreal keyframe
sections.note: Left: cleaned storyboard sketch (source, red arrows removed). Right: nano photoreal render used as the i2v first frame.

experiments.approach: sketch → nano photoreal → i2v (saw cuts, sawdust, zoom-in)
experiments.note: Strong result: photoreal Makita rear-handle saw cutting a board, spinning blade (motion blur), sawdust spray, slow zoom-in. No face.
experiments.prompt: Animate @Image1 (image-to-video). @Image1 is a photoreal Makita 7-1/4" rear-handle circular saw cutting along a board, held by a pro's two hands (hands and forearms only, NO face in frame). MOTION: the blade spins fast, the saw pushes steadily FORWARD along the cut line through the board, fine sawdust sprays out from the blade, and the CAMERA does a slow smooth ZOOM-IN / push toward the saw (per the 'MED ZOOM LENS' shot). Keep it photoreal and cinematic — warm workshop lighting, shallow depth of field, the teal-and-black Makita saw sharp. No on-screen text, no captions, no arrows, no added logos (only the tool's own MAKITA marking).

sections.label: 0002 · Shot 806 — The Most Demanding: grinder sparks (DONE)
sections.note: Sketch → nano photoreal render → i2v. Angle grinder cutting a steel weld, animated shower of sparks, spinning disc. Person-free (R3: the first render had a torso+gloves and R3-rejected; re-rendered person-free to pass). VO: 'BUILT FOR THE MOST DEMANDING JOBS.'

sections.label: Inputs — sketch → photoreal keyframe (person-free)
sections.note: Left: cleaned storyboard sketch. Right: nano photoreal render (person removed so it passes the R3 filter as an i2v input).

experiments.approach: sketch → nano photoreal (person-free) → i2v (spinning disc, spark shower)
experiments.note: Dynamic animated sparks + spinning disc, real teal/black Makita LXT grinder, dark cinematic. No people. LESSON: i2v keyframes with a visible torso/gloves can trip R3 even though 'hands only' passes — keep tool macros person-free.
experiments.prompt: Animate @Image1 (image-to-video). A photoreal Makita 18V LXT angle grinder cutting a steel pipe/weld, gloved hands on it (hands only, NO face). MOTION: the round cutting disc SPINS fast and a continuous bright shower of orange SPARKS sprays outward toward the camera, flickering and glowing; the grinder holds against the metal with a slight vibration/shake; a thin curl of smoke. Dark cinematic lighting so the sparks glow, shallow depth of field, subtle motion blur on the sparks. Keep the teal-and-black Makita grinder sharp. No on-screen text, no captions, no arrows, no added logos (only the tool's own MAKITA/LXT markings).
